title: vaximile pipeline - params.samplesheet schema
description: Schema for the file provided with params.samplesheet

patient.errorMessage: Patient identifier must be provided and cannot contain spaces

somatic_name.errorMessage: Somatic (tumour/normal pairing) identifier must be provided and cannot contain spaces

sample_name.errorMessage: Sample name must be provided and cannot contain spaces

sample_type.errorMessage: Sample type must be one of 'Tumor' or 'Normal'

sequencing_type.errorMessage: Sequencing type must be one of 'exome', 'genome', 'exome_FFPE', 'genome_FFPE' or 'rna'

sex.errorMessage: Sex must be 'XX' or 'XY', or left blank

capture_kit.errorMessage: Capture kit must match a 'kit' entry in the capture kit sheet. Leave blank for RNA rows.

fastqr1.errorMessage: FastQ file for read 1 must be provided, cannot contain spaces and must have extension '.fq.gz' or '.fastq.gz'

fastqr2.errorMessage: FastQ file for read 2 must be provided, cannot contain spaces and must have extension '.fq.gz' or '.fastq.gz'
